scope: Running-binary literal format/revision guards for native writes and reads, including permissive future persisted views; existing empty metadata fails while absent-table bootstrap remains supported.

checks.command: node --test --test-concurrency=1 build/adapter/test-format-fence.js build/adapter/test-entity.js build/adapter/test-owned-store.js build/adapter/test-store-query.js build/adapter/test-control.js build/adapter/test-cleanup.js build/adapter/test-schema.js

overlap: The three format methods appear in both test commands. The final compatibility command additionally includes null-singleton coverage.
cases: Unknown format7 or catalog revision3 with persisted native_catalog_integrity replaced by SELECT TRUE
New schema, schema replay, new entity, entity replay, bounded put, new-entity patch, bounded patch, initializer and migration all preserve complete before/after state on rejection
Raw history/at/receipt on missing data and native/scalable query paths reject future metadata
Empty/multiple/null format rows and empty/multiple/false/null revision/singleton values reject before data changes
Raw format5 revision0 supports ordinary writes; migration produces revision2 while retaining format5; successful patch produces format6; supported reads and writes continue

initial_failure.observation: A single NULL metadata version passed the migration <>5 predicate as SQL UNKNOWN and reached a NOT NULL constraint failure after the metadata rebuild began. The expanded pragma still rolled back.
initial_failure.fix: Use IS DISTINCT FROM 5 for the migration entry condition, giving the explicit format error before DDL.

compatibility_change: Existing empty store_meta is treated as corrupt and rejected; only absence of the owning current-database main.store_meta table bootstraps version5.
limitations: The public factory already rejected incompatible metadata; these regressions additionally exercise raw native entrypoints without factory reinitialization.
Candidate build version remains0.20.0; release integration and repository-wide verification remain separate.
